fields.display_title: This paper studies the critical points of shallow and deep linear networks. The authors give a (necessary and sufficient) characterization of the form of critical points and use this to derive necessary and sufficient conditions for which critical points are global optima. While the exposition of the paper can be improved in my view this is a neat and concise result and merits publication in ICLR.
